messages.subject: Looking for Mentors
parts:
Hi 

I am Fahrozi, from Indonesia,  currently I am studying master of Applied math at Budapest university of Technology and economics, I have plan to join Gsoc in this year. because of this year in my country there is a president election so I wanna doing project related about Election data
I interested to use these packages :

https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/eechidna/index.html

https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/elections_1.0.tar.gz

or if you have an idea about this project, with pleasure we can discuss it.

Looking forward to hearing from you all.

Thank you in advance

Best regards,
Fahrozi

messages.author: 43d45a846d16a3b9
messages.subject: Re: Looking for Mentors
parts:
Hi Fahrozi,

I am one of the authors of the eechidna package, and I’ve cc’d both Jeremy Forbes who has greatly expanded the package recently, and Ben Marwick, the original developer and maintainer. I can’t be a mentor but both Ben and Jeremy said they may be able to mentor your project. 

A first question: where would you get data on the Indonesian elections? Is it readily available? 

cheers,
Di
